content:
AirPods Pro 3 is reduced by 25%, creating one of the lowest price offers ever is still in effect, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break starts with these M5 MacBook Air configurations, still reduced by $270 in the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and these 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular models reduced by $100. We also have the all-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband on its first price drop, Hyper's 2026 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure Mac accessory returning to an all-time low on Amazon, and Nomad's leather and Sport series iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases on clearance with prices starting from $17. Full details below.

The latest AirPods Pro 3 still maintain one of the lowest prices on Amazon... for now (about 25% off)

Not only are the latest AirPods Max 2 still $100 off across all five colors, Amazon is also selling the latest AirPods Pro 3 at a solid 24% discount. Previously reduced by $200 during the July "Black Friday," Amazon has gone even lower, and as of writing this offer is still in effect.

Amazon is currently selling Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $189.99 with free shipping to your home.

Originally priced at $249, now at nearly 25% off, it is one of the lowest prices we have recorded so far.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $149 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $119 (originally new $179) — Renewed Premium Refurbished

These M5 MacBook Air configurations are reduced by $270 today in the official Apple Refurbished Store, still with full warranty

Although we have seen some scattered configurations in new condition with $100 and $150 discounts on Amazon, since the price increase, M5 MacBook Air deals on retail channels have been lackluster and short-lived. The official Apple Refurbished Store offers considerable savings opportunities, and today we picked out several 13-inch and 15-inch models, all reduced by $270.

The deals we are highlighting today include a 13-inch model with 24GB/1TB and a 16GB/1TB configuration, both at the same price, $270 off the original price:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • Midnight, Starlight and Sky Blue
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • Midnight, Silver, Starlight and Sky Blue

Compared to the brand-new models, the 15-inch model above sells for $1,699 on Amazon ($100 off), but only two colors remain; as for the 13-inch 24GB model, Sky Blue sells for $1,649 ($150 off), while other colors cost at least $50 more.

As of now, a $150 discount on a brand-new M5 MacBook Air is actually considered a decent deal, but the Apple Certified Refurbished Store now offers almost a deeper discount, along with a full one-year Apple warranty.

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular models with $100 off, deals starting from $299

Although we are still tracking the most entry-level GPS-only Apple Watch Series 11 with a $100 discount, Amazon has now restocked the 46mm GPS + cellular model, also offering a $100 price reduction.

Amazon is currently selling the 46mm GPS + cellular Apple Watch Series 11 for $429, available in multiple case colors, with free shipping to your home.

Originally priced at $529, that is a straight $100 off, matching the lowest prices we have recorded over the past month or so.

However, Amazon has recently had difficulty maintaining stock of the lowest-priced 46mm cellular models, and now Jet Black, Silver and Rose Gold colors are all offering $100 off.

We saw these configurations priced $30 lower during Prime Day previously, but this offer has now matched the best price since then.

The entry-level model deals are still in effect:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

We also have Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations in Black Titanium and Natural Titanium, paired with Black and Anchor Blue Ocean bands, reduced to $699.99 with free shipping — nearly $100 off.

All-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto entry sees first price drop

Among the first models compatible with Apple Home and featuring "out-of-the-box" Ultra Wideband technology, we are now tracking the all-new Schlage Sense Pro UWB smart door lock seeing its first substantive price drop on Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the brand-new Schlage Sense Pro UWB smart door lock with Apple Home Key support for $338.74 with free shipping to your home.

Originally priced at $400, although it is not a huge discount, we are talking about one of the newest door lock solutions, from one of the well-known brands in this category, giving you the first chance to save. As mentioned above, it is also one of the few models that simultaneously support Apple Home and Ultra Wideband technology for automatic locking and unlocking:

This Matter-compatible smart lock (requires a Thread-compatible smart home hub — Apple TV 4K, HomePod 2nd generation, or HomePod Mini) will use "Ultra Wideband combined with the user's home key and a compatible iPhone or Apple Watch to achieve seamless touch-free unlocking." The brand says it can provide intuitive touch-free entry, "by calculating speed, trajectory and movement to understand the user's intent to enter, so that the lock precisely unlocks as soon as the user arrives at the door."

Hyper 2026 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure Mac accessory drops to new low on Amazon, $80 off

If you are looking for a suitable Thunderbolt 5 Dock for your Mac setup, experience tells me that many cheaper models actually do not perform well. However, this feature-packed 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure model is more than capable, and has now dropped to an all-time low on Amazon.

Amazon is once again selling the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for $319.99 with free shipping to your home.

Nomad leather and Sport series iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases on clearance with prices starting from $17 (up to 75% off)

With the iPhone 18 series arriving next month, Nomad is discounting and clearing out its existing leather and Sport series iPhone 17 Pro/Max cases, at up to 75% off the suggested retail price.

Although not all models are still in stock, Nomad is now essentially selling off the remaining inventory of leather iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max cases, along with some of the more affordable Sport models, with deals starting from $17.

Not all colors and sizes are in stock or discounted this low, but be sure to check the three link pages below for 17 Pro and Pro Max sizes and other color options:

  • Rugged Leather Case $21 (originally $85)
  • Modern Leather Case $30 (originally $69)
  • Sport Case $17 (originally $55)

Getting Nomad's popular cases at these prices is almost unprecedented — it requires a clearance sale. If you are not absolutely committed to buying an 18 Pro or other new Apple products coming next month, these are absolutely some of the most worthwhile cases on the market.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker 140W 4-Port MacBook Charger with smart display slashed to $56 today
  • Get 4 Matter smart plugs with automatic night lights for under $5 each today (all-time low)
  • UGREEN 160W Nexode Pro with display can charge 5 devices at once, now slashed to $60
  • UGREEN 65W Nexode Air is one of the smallest chargers we have seen, nearly 50% off, now only $21.50
  • David Pogue's "Apple: The First 50 Years" hardcover book, now $26 on Amazon (originally $50)

Apple Watch Ultra 3 Ocean band configurations nearly $100 off on Amazon

In addition to the ongoing near-25% discount on AirPods Pro 3, Amazon brought back the nearly $100 discount on Apple Watch Ultra 3 Ocean band configurations this morning.

Amazon is currently selling the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium versions of the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with the Black Ocean band, as well as the Anchor Blue version, for $699.99 with free shipping to your home.

Originally priced at $700 for the configurations, now reduced by $99, it is the lowest price we have found. It seems stock of the black version is already running low.

Over the past week we have seen the Natural version with Blue Trail Loop discounted by $129 a few times, but this highlight offer matches the lowest prices we saw during the July "Black Friday" and early August Ocean band deals.

Best Buy's previous Apple Shopping Event also had deals on these models, but at most only $49 off, and they are still selling for $750 today.

These deals and the lineup also include the lowest-priced Apple Watch Series 11 models with $100 off, starting from $299, for those not interested in high-end versions like the Ultra 3:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular $399 starting (originally $499)

This week's 4-day Apple sale brings $100 back off all AirPods Max 2 colors

Although Amazon's Apple sale this weekend has pushed AirPods Pro 3 prices even lower, the $100 discount on Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 remains in effect.

Amazon is currently selling the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2 over-ear headphones in all five colors for $449 with free shipping to your home.

Originally priced at $549, that is $100 off, the lowest price we have found.

This weekend's deals are a continuation of the "Black Friday" and July discounts. Although individual colors briefly rose earlier, they have all now returned to the $100-off level.

Since going on sale at the beginning of this year, the only time we have seen this brand-new next-generation AirPods Max 2 priced lower than now was during the late June Prime Day deal; otherwise, this is the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon.
